button.label: Add/Edit Citation
button.supertip: Insert a new citation, or edit the citation at the current cursor position (Shortcuts: Alt+Z or Ctrl+Alt+C)

button.label: Add/Edit Refs
button.supertip: Insert a new bibliography, or edit the existing bibliography, at the current cursor position (Shortcut: Alt+B)

button.label: Refresh
button.supertip: Update all citations and bibliography to reflect changes in Zotero (Shortcut: Alt+R)

button.label: Preferences
button.supertip: Change the citation style or locale

button.label: Add Note
button.supertip: Insert a new note at the current cursor position

button.label: Unlink
button.supertip: Remove all Zotero field codes and unlink from Zotero library

button.label: Export
button.supertip: Export the document to switch to another word processor
